settings.title: Settings
settings.fontScaleHint: Scales the whole UI; pick larger for high-DPI screens.
settings.fontFamilyHint: Body type; code blocks stay monospace either way.
settings.customFontFamilyHint: CSS font-family value for the whole desktop UI.
settings.searchEnginesHint: web_search uses the engine marked Active. Expand a card to set its key or endpoint.
settings.searchEngineNeedsBrowser: Install {browser} on the MCP page first
settings.searchEngineNoSetup: No setup needed: this engine works without a key or endpoint.
settings.searchSharedKeyNote: This engine uses the {provider} API key from the Models tab.
settings.noProvidersDeclared: No model provider is declared. Add a providers/<id>.json file to packages/core-utils/src/providers/ and run npm run providers:sync.
settings.noSearchEnginesDeclared: No search engine is declared. Add a search-engines/<id>.json file to packages/core-utils/src/search-engines/ and run npm run providers:sync.
settings.webSearchApiKeyModelsHint: Managed on the Models tab under {provider}.
settings.pageQuickSendDesc: Composer quick actions and their hotkeys
settings.pageFallbacksDesc: Automatic failover when a provider runs out of quota
settings.pagePluginsDesc: Agent plugins: skills and MCP servers from a Codex-layout manifest
settings.feedbackCueInputRequiredHint: Command or file approval, plan approval, multiple-choice questions, checkpoints and revisions.
settings.feedbackCuePlanCompleteHint: Every step of the active plan has been completed.
settings.feedbackCueGuardTriggeredHint: The repetition guard stopped a degenerating model stream (opt in under Tools).
settings.soundSectionHint: Each pack keeps its own switch and volume per cue. Cues play through the pack marked Active, and a cue switched on here also raises its desktop notification while the window is unfocused.
settings.packWizardNameHint: Names the card and the folder that stores the audio.
settings.packWizardSoundsHint: Pick the sound that represents each cue. A cue left empty stays silent in this pack.
settings.voiceSectionHint: Select a speech-to-text recognition model. Models download on demand into the local cache.
settings.voiceInputDeviceHint: Choose the microphone used for voice input. The system default is used until you pick one.
settings.voiceInputDeviceAllowHint: Voice input stays off until you grant microphone access. Granting it reveals your microphones and unlocks the audio test below.
settings.voiceInputDeviceTestHint: Records a few seconds from the selected microphone and plays it back so you can confirm it captures audio.
settings.voiceRuntimeNote: Needs a {size} Python runtime, installed once and reused across updates.
settings.defaultModelHint: Used for the main session and every subagent.
settings.modelVisibilityHint: All models are off by default. Enable the ones you want; enabled models appear in every picker.
settings.fallbacksHint: When the active model's provider reports an exhausted quota or rate limit, the chat switches to the first usable model below and keeps working, so a queued or overnight run never sits idle. Order is priority. The switch applies to the open conversation only: it never changes the default model for new chats.
settings.fallbacksEmpty: No backup models yet. Add one below to survive a provider that runs out of quota mid-conversation.
settings.fallbacksNeedsEnabledModels: No models are enabled yet. Turn on the models you want in Settings → Models; backups are chosen from that list.
settings.ollamaModelsHint: Fetched live from the endpoint; pick one to use it.
settings.experientialApiKeyHint: Paste an Experiential Labs gateway key (starts `xpl_`). It routes any gateway model slug through https://api.experientiallabs.ai/v1.
settings.ollamaSubscription: {count} models require an Ollama subscription (plan: {plan}). Upgrade at ollama.com to unlock them.
settings.mcpNotBridged: · Current desktop session not bridged: restart Reasonix+ to take effect
settings.mcpEmpty: No MCP servers configured yet. Enter a spec below to add one.
settings.mcpOnlyPluginServers: Every server here comes from a plugin, so it is listed on that plugin's card in Settings > Plugins.
settings.mcpToolToggleHint: Disabled tools stay unregistered until re-enabled
settings.mcpBrowserDesc: Choose a workspace-persistent managed browser, attach to an already-running Chrome/Edge browser through the extension, or connect another Chromium browser through CDP.
settings.mcpConfiguredNo: playwright server not configured yet: choose a mode and configure it
settings.mcpTokenHint: Chrome/Edge only. Attaches to the browser if it is already running and reuses its tabs, logins, settings, and installed extensions. The optional relay token skips the per-connection approval prompt.
settings.mcpCdpHint: For Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, and similar browsers started with a remote debugging endpoint.
settings.mcpBrowserDownloadBackup: Official source failed: retrying from the Reasonix+ mirror
settings.mcpConnDisabled: server disabled: enable it to bridge
settings.mcpConnIdle: configured but not bridged yet: connects when a session starts
settings.pluginsEmpty: No plugin installed yet. Install one from a GitHub repository, a git URL, or a local directory to add its skills and MCP servers.
settings.pluginsInstallHint: Accepts owner/repo, a git URL, or an absolute directory. A Codex-layout plugin declares .codex-plugin/plugin.json with skills and mcpServers.
settings.pluginsPerSession: Plugins install here for every workspace. Enable or Disable sets the default a new chat starts from; like MCP servers, the set a chat may use is chosen when that chat starts, and the choice is frozen for the session so installing or removing one never invalidates a running conversation's cache.
settings.pluginsNoServers: This plugin declares no MCP servers.
settings.skillsEmpty: No standalone skill installed yet. Install one from a git URL or a local directory holding a SKILL.md.
settings.skillsInstallHint: Accepts a git URL, owner/repo, or an absolute directory. One SKILL.md at the root installs a single skill; a folder of skill directories, such as skills/ or .agents/skills, installs every skill it holds.
settings.skillsPerSession: Skills install here for every workspace. Which ones a chat may use is chosen when that chat starts, like MCP servers and plugins: the choice is frozen for the session so installing or removing one never invalidates a running conversation's cache.
settings.skillsGroupInferred: Grouped by their shared id prefix: these skills were installed before sources were recorded, so reinstalling the repository gives the group its real name.
settings.capabilityRemovedNote: Removing a plugin, skill or MCP server here also drops it from the chats that had it enabled: a chat only ever uses what is installed.
settings.mcpTestRunning: testing relay: approve in Chrome or Edge if the dialog appears…
settings.mcpTestOk: ✓ token works: browser attached in {ms} ms
settings.outlookMailDesc: Connect a personal Outlook or Hotmail account. Reasonix+ runs a local mail-only MCP server and completes Microsoft device-code authentication here.
settings.outlookMailCodeLabel: Enter this code on the Microsoft page
settings.outlookMailStatusUnknown: Outlook Mail is not configured yet.
settings.outlookMailPrivacy: OAuth tokens stay in the local MCP server's credential cache and never enter the Reasonix+ UI or config. Sending email remains an explicit tool action.
settings.mailDesc: Connect a mail account so Reasonix+ can read and compose messages. Choose a provider below; each keeps its own authentication.
settings.gmailMailDesc: Connect a personal Gmail account through your own Google OAuth client. Create a Desktop app OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, add the redirect URI below, then paste its client ID and secret here.
settings.gmailSaved: saved: enter a new value to replace
settings.gmailCallbackHint: Register this redirect URI in your Google OAuth client: {url}
settings.quickSendHint: Create, delete, or reorder the quick actions offered in the composer dropdown. ⌘ Q opens that dropdown, and ⌘ 1-9 fires the first nine rows in this order.

contextPanel.autoCompactEnabledDesc: Older context is summarized automatically before a turn as the context window fills.
contextPanel.autoCompactDisabledDesc: Context is never compacted automatically; use Compact now.
contextPanel.compactThresholdTooltip: Auto-compaction fires at {pct}% of the window
contextPanel.elevationEnabledDesc: run_command can run a command elevated via the Windows UAC prompt. Each elevated run still asks for approval and shows the UAC dialog.
contextPanel.elevationDisabledDesc: Elevated commands are blocked. run_command refuses elevate=true until this is enabled.
contextPanel.repetitionGuardEnabledDesc: Auto-stops a stream whose output degenerates into a repeated pattern (reasoning, content, or tool calls).
contextPanel.repetitionGuardDisabledDesc: Off by default: a degenerate stream is allowed to finish. Enable to auto-stop a model stuck re-thinking the same point.
contextPanel.questionTimerEnabledDesc: Picks the first option after a 30s countdown on every Never Ask picker (questions, plans, revisions).
contextPanel.questionTimerDisabledDesc: Off: choice questions (ask_choice, abandon/activate plan) wait for a manual pick in Never Ask mode.
contextPanel.duplicateSessionLimitDesc: Token budget kept when duplicating a session: the newest part of the transcript is kept and the oldest is dropped.
contextPanel.duplicateSessionAutoProceedOnDesc: A duplicated session runs one turn automatically to continue where the previous one left off.
contextPanel.duplicateSessionAutoProceedOffDesc: Off: a duplicated session is seeded with the truncated context and waits; you send the next message.
contextPanel.ollamaGenerationHelp: Sampling controls for Ollama main agents and subagents in this tab.
contextPanel.ollamaResetTooltip: Reset to environment, Reasonix+ default, or model default
contextPanel.ollamaPresetDefaultTooltip: Reset all sampling options to model defaults
contextPanel.ollamaPresetCodingTooltip: Low temperature (0.2) and top P (0.9) for precise code and tool calling
contextPanel.ollamaPresetBalancedTooltip: Balanced temperature (0.7) and sampling for general reasoning
contextPanel.ollamaPresetCreativeTooltip: High temperature (1.0) and top P (0.95) for brainstorming and exploration
contextPanel.ollamaPresetAntiLoopTooltip: Moderate temperature with gentle repetition penalty (1.1) to avoid loops
contextPanel.changeEffectHint: Click to switch this rule between its mode's effects
contextPanel.copyRulesNoSource: No other workspace has rules yet
contextPanel.copyRulesHint: Copy another workspace's rules here, replacing this workspace's
contextPanel.ruleRowOutsidePathsPattern: absolute paths beyond the workspace root
contextPanel.ruleRowOutlookPattern: send-mail from your signed-in Outlook account
contextPanel.ruleRegexHint: Case-insensitive regex against the full command. Require both words: ^(?=.*\bgit\b)(?=.*\bpush\b).* (no / delimiters). Slow patterns refuse the command.
